newsitem.title: USA: Kmart debt up on improved operating results.
newsitem.headline: Kmart debt up on improved operating results.

text.p: Debt of Kmart Corp traded 1/4 point higher on Wednesday, boosted by positive news about the retailer's fourth-quarter operating results, traders said.
"Kmart's 12.50 percent paper is up 1/4 and trading at a 120 bid, 121 offer," said one high-yield trader.
On Wednesday, the company said cost-cutting allowed it to slash its fourth quarter net losses by 61 percent and post its best full year profit from continuing operations in four years.

Kmart said its fourth-quarter net loss, which included writeoffs and losses from Kmart's discontinued Builders Square unit, came to $164 million, or $0.27 a share, compared with a year-earlier loss of $420 million, or $0.91 a share.
Kmart's senior unsecured debt is rated Ba3 by Moody's Investors Service Inc and B-plus by Standard & Poor's.
